# Guppy Multiple Moving Average

*Six short and six long EMAs: trader and investor groups.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Guppy Multiple Moving Average** under **Moving averages**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Short-term color | color | `"#00BCD4"` |
| Long-term color | color | `"#F23645"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/gmma.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Guppy Multiple Moving Average", shortTitle: "GMMA", overlay: true });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const shortColor = input.color("Short-term color", "#00BCD4", { group: "Style" }), longColor = input.color("Long-term color", "#F23645", { group: "Style" });
for (const n of [3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15]) plot(ta.ema(src, n), { title: `Short ${n}`, color: shortColor });
for (const n of [30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60]) plot(ta.ema(src, n), { title: `Long ${n}`, color: longColor });
```
